_comment_preproc: Turns BaSiC illumination correction on (off by default).
_comment_seg_method: stardist is the default; the alternatives are instantseg and cellsam.
_comment_resources: max_cpus, max_memory and max_time are not set here: they are per site and belong in your -c site.config (from conf/site.config.template). A -params-file value overrides -c, so setting them here would defeat it.
